PROMPT: Get vehicles for levels make, year when Make is 'INTERNATIONAL'
QUERY_TEXT:
SELECT
  make.make AS make
  ,year.year AS year
  ,vehicles
FROM ANALYTIC VIEW (
  USING ctf_calf_vehicle_fuel_types_av
    HIERARCHIES (
       make
       ,year)
  )
WHERE
  make.level_name = 'MAKE'
  AND year.level_name = 'YEAR'
  AND make = 'INTERNATIONAL'
ORDER BY 
  make.make
  ,year.year

PROMPT: Fetch vehicles with levels make, year filter by Make is 'ROLLS-ROYCE'

  ,vehicles
